name: Hibari Flight
description: Hibari Flight — a theme for a private pilot flight school. A white page with one big photograph window that has a single rounded corner and the headline lying on the photo, drawn larks, a windsock and a headset perched on the edges of square photographs, a drawn airfield circuit with a travelling lark, and a deep navy lesson band with a horizontal strip of slides. Schibsted Grotesk for headings, Public Sans for reading. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German.
